decisions.statement: A caller hands in one alias or a list of aliases.
A registered command becomes a subcommand of the global command.
A callable is a function or a table the game may call.
A version already loaded keeps a second load of the same file from running.
Chat input is started only where the game permits talking to the target.
A wrapped function is called with the function wrapped as its first argument.
